title: Kinase panel 4-compound dose–response curves
what: IC50 of the most potent compound (nM)

reader_questions.question: What is the IC50 (the concentration giving 50% inhibition) of the most potent compound, in nM?
How are replicate measurements represented?
reader_questions.expected: Triplicates (n = 3 per concentration) shown via points and/or error bars.

reader_questions.question: Why is concentration plotted on a logarithmic axis?
reader_questions.expected: Concentrations span 0.1 to 3000 nM in half-log steps across 4+ orders of magnitude.
